summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/notifications@41.3.1 declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with _0x-style identifier mangling and string-map indirections. It downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (version 1.3.13), extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses that alternate runtime to execute a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. If bun is already on PATH, it directly invokes `bun math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line obfuscator.io-style payload marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` consisting of a rotating string-array (WV8StW shift routine), a 1000+ entry mixed hex/codepoint constant table, and String.fromCodePoint reconstruction. The package's advertised purpose is a React notifications UI library, which does not require downloading a second JavaScript runtime at install time or executing an obfuscated 727KB blob. Using an alternate runtime to execute the payload evades Node-based supply-chain scanners and static review. This matches the alternate-runtime-dropper attack pattern: install-time execution of attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
